note: List prices, read by scripts/cost_estimate.py. verified=false means no current public source confirmed the number.

agora_audio_task.note: Same rate with our own keys (BYOK). The managed key includes ARES, Deepgram nova-2/3, MiniMax 2.6/2.8 Turbo and OpenAI TTS-1. An older release note (v1.6) speaks of a separate 'ARES ASR Task'; the current pricing page does not.

openai.note: gpt-4o-transcribe, OpenAI's own per-minute estimate (billed as $2.50/1M input, $10/1M output tokens), billed by OpenAI on MODEL_API_KEY. Whether Agora sends all audio or only speech is not known: minutes x price is an upper bound.

ares.note: Included in the Agora audio task (managed key).

minimax.note: MiniMax 2.8 Turbo is on Agora's managed-key list: included in the audio task.

cartesia.note: Cartesia worked with credential_mode managed (2026-11-21 probe) but is NOT on Agora's included list; how it is billed is undocumented.
